title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Ten no-purchase outings around Franklin & Marshall College and Lancaster, including galleries, gardens, library activities, and a dog park.

cards.title: Browse F&M’s Campus Galleries
cards.subtitle: A free art stop inside Steinman College Center
cards.notes: Meet at Steinman College Center and explore the current exhibition together; check the museum page first for seasonal closures.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus gallery outing with rotating exhibitions and no admission charge.
cards.evidence_claim: F&M states that the Phillips Museum of Art is free and open to all; it operates Tuesday through Sunday during the academic year.
cards.access_notes: The museum is closed for summer and is scheduled to reopen September 8, 2026; academic-year hours are Tuesday–Sunday, noon–4 p.m.

cards.entity_name: Pennsylvania College of Art & Design Main Gallery
cards.title: See Contemporary Art on Prince Street
cards.subtitle: A public gallery in PCA&D’s main entrance
cards.notes: Walk downtown with friends, compare reactions to the current exhibition, and confirm weekend availability during the academic year.
cards.short_summary: A downtown contemporary-art visit that works for a casual group afternoon.
cards.evidence_claim: Pennsylvania College of Art & Design states that its Main Gallery is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Main Gallery - Pennsylvania College of Art & Design
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m.; weekend hours of 10 a.m.–5 p.m. apply during the academic year.

cards.title: Take an Arboretum Walk
cards.subtitle: Eleven acres beside Wheatland
cards.notes: Choose a dawn-to-dusk window, stroll the grounds at your own pace, and look for champion trees, conifers, and pollinator gardens.
cards.short_summary: A self-guided garden walk through an arboretum containing more than 100 tree species.
cards.evidence_claim: LancasterHistory says the Tanger Arboretum is open from dawn to dusk and has no cost or admission fee.
cards.access_notes: The outdoor grounds are open dawn to dusk with no main entrance; visitors may walk at their leisure.

cards.title: Explore Wheatland Online
cards.subtitle: A free virtual tour of James Buchanan’s home
cards.notes: Open the 360-degree tour on a shared screen, move through the rooms together, and pause at artifact hotspots and educational videos.
cards.short_summary: A remote history hang that explores Wheatland without buying an in-person ticket.
cards.evidence_claim: LancasterHistory describes its Wheatland 360° Virtual Field Trip as free and available for anyone to view online.
cards.access_notes: Available online; this card covers only the virtual field trip because entry to Wheatland’s interior requires a paid ticket.

cards.title: Join a Free Library Program
cards.subtitle: Community activities at the Lancaster City Branch
cards.notes: Check the library calendar, pick an age-appropriate program with friends, and review its listing for registration or supply requirements.
cards.short_summary: A flexible social outing built around the library’s changing program calendar.
cards.evidence_claim: Lancaster Public Library says it offers a wealth of free programs and links visitors to its program calendar.
cards.access_notes: Program schedules, eligibility, and registration vary; verify the individual calendar listing before attending.

cards.title: Plan a Seed-Swap Project
cards.subtitle: Free seeds and gardening education without a library card
cards.notes: Visit with a gardening-minded friend, choose seeds you can realistically grow, and record the requested information before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A hands-on library activity for starting a shared garden or windowsill planting.
cards.evidence_claim: The library says participation in its Seed Library has no charge and does not require a library card.
cards.access_notes: Anyone may participate without a library card; visit during Lancaster City Branch operating hours.

cards.title: Plan a Dog-Park Meetup
cards.subtitle: Separate play areas inside Buchanan Park
cards.notes: Bring a dog only if you can follow the posted rules, choose the correct size area, and pack water and cleanup supplies for the visit.
cards.short_summary: A dawn-to-dusk meetup for dog owners at a free city dog park with splash pads.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Lancaster states that Beau’s Dream Dog Park is free to enter and open year-round from dawn until dusk.
cards.access_notes: Open year-round from dawn to dusk; follow the city’s posted dog-park rules and use the appropriate dog-size area.

cards.entity_name: Demuth Museum of Art on King
cards.title: Tour Charles Demuth’s Home and Studio
cards.subtitle: A small museum in a historic East King Street rowhome
cards.notes: Allow about 30–45 minutes to see the rooms, rotating displays, and garden; check exhibition details before gathering your group.
cards.short_summary: An intimate art-and-history visit focused on Lancaster modernist Charles Demuth.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum lists admission as by donation with a suggested donation, meaning no mandatory admission purchase is stated.
cards.source_title: Hours & Locations — Demuth Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Regular hours are Tuesday, Thursday–Saturday 10 a.m.–4 p.m. and Sunday noon–4 p.m.; donations are optional.

cards.entity_name: Demuth Museum of Art on Lime
cards.title: Catch a Community Exhibition
cards.subtitle: Changing exhibitions in the historic Grubb Mansion
cards.notes: Check that an exhibition is installed, then pair a gallery visit with a walk through adjacent Musser Park without making a purchase.
cards.short_summary: A rotating community-art outing in a historic house beside Musser Park.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum lists admission as by donation and publishes exhibition-specific hours for its Lime Street location.
cards.source_title: Hours & Locations — Demuth Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Closed between exhibitions; verify the exhibition calendar. During listed exhibitions, donations are optional rather than required.

cards.title: Apply to the Teen Art Council
cards.subtitle: A free October-to-June arts program for local high-school students
cards.notes: Eligible teens can review the application, confirm the current cycle, and apply to help shape field trips, events, and service projects.
cards.short_summary: A recurring no-fee arts council where local teens help develop museum programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Demuth Museum of Art states that its Teen Art Council is entirely free and is designed for local high-school students.
cards.access_notes: Limited to accepted local high-school students; the program runs October–June and requires an application.

warnings: Phillips Museum of Art is seasonally closed until September 8, 2026.
Demuth Museum of Art on Lime closes between exhibitions; visitors should confirm the exhibition calendar.
Demuth Teen Art Council is eligibility-limited and application-based.
